description:
List a store's SKUs, including drafts and archived ones.

Params: store_id, session_token?
Returns: {entries: Sku[]} (price is base units of the SKU's currency — currency, currencyAddress, currencySymbol, currencyDecimals; null = not for sale)
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_404

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_list_skus
title: List store items
